tool_config.name: resolve_needed_by
tool_config.description: Work out the day and time from when the Foreman said the need is needed. Call it as soon as the Foreman says when, with their words, before the read-back. Returns {"needed_by_resolved": "Monday, November 2 at 7:00 AM", "urgency": "Planned"}; needed_by_resolved is null when the words could not be worked out. Returns {"error": "..."} if it failed.

request_body_schema.description: When it is needed, as the Foreman said it.

needed_by_spoken.description: When it is needed, exactly as the Foreman said it, for example 'tomorrow at seven' or 'first thing'. Do not convert it.
